subject: Draft MAP: Northbridge systems - acceptance criteria, owners, and signature readiness
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Connors <evan.connors@northbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP (draft) — Northbridge / Redwood

Evan — great to speak today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary:
- Goal: Replace in-house inference stack for search-ranking with Redwood hosted inference.
- Initial scope: 2 models (reranker + embedder), pilot traffic ~5% of queries, then ramp to 40% over 8 weeks.

Draft MAP attached: MAP_Northbridge_Draft_v1.xlsx (milestones below). Key asks from Northbridge: procurement timeline, SOC2 evidence, and VPC peering cadence.

High-level milestones (target dates):
- 11/17: Legal & procurement redline window opens (Northbridge legal)
- 11/24: Security review complete (SOC2 summary + architecture)
- 12/01: Infra provisioned (VPC peering, IP allowlist)
- 12/08: Pilot end-to-end validation (quality + latency SLOs)
- 12/15: Go-live (production traffic shift)

Owners (draft):
- Northbridge: Evan Connors (Product) — acceptance criteria, legal signoff via procurement@northbridge.com
- Redwood: Priyom Das (Sales) — commercial coordination, Ben Carter (Solutions) — implementation & runbook, Marissa Cole (CS) — launch ops

Dependencies / blockers:
- Procurement signature + PO (target before 11/30)
- Legal redlines cleared (we can turn around standard redlines quickly; complex indemnity/DP clauses will take longer)
- Security checklist: SOC2 report, data residency notes, network architecture diagram

Ask from Northbridge: please confirm target close date (we proposed 12/15) and provide names for any additional internal approvers. If you want, Ben can send a cleaned MAP with owners populated by EOD 11/11.

Thanks — attaching the draft MAP and a short SOC2 summary from our side.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: MAP_Northbridge_Draft_v1.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

From: Evan Connors <evan.connors@northbridge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Northbridge Procurement <procurement@northbridge.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP (draft) — Northbridge / Redwood

Thanks Priyom — useful recap. A few quick notes from our side: 

1) Go-live: we need to shift the target go-live to 2026-12-15 instead of 12/15 — that works but we need procurement/finance to sign PO by 11/30.
2) Owners: I will be the product owner; procurement will own contract/PO (procurement@northbridge.com). Please add my infra lead (Lena Park) and my security contact (Carlos Mendez) to the MAP so they see milestones.
3) Security artifacts: please send SOC2 report (we can accept summary + AOC), an architecture diagram, and a short data-flow note showing PII handling.

Ben — if you can populate the MAP with the named owners (Lena, Carlos) and update milestone dates to reflect the 12/15 go-live that would help.

I attached a short note from procurement on their approval window.

Regards,
Evan
VP Product, Northbridge Systems
evan.connors@northbridge.com

> On Nov 10, 2026, at 3:20 PM, Priyom Das <priom.das@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [original message omitted]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Connors <evan.connors@northbridge.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP (draft) — Northbridge / Redwood

Evan — thanks. I've updated the owners and moved the target go-live to 2026-12-15 in the MAP (see attached MAP_Northbridge_v2.xlsx). Key implementation notes: 

- Redwood owners: Ben Carter (implementation lead) — overall runbook; Marissa Cole (CS) — launch ops & post-launch health; Infra escalation: infra-oncall@redwood.ai
- Northbridge owners added: Lena Park (Infra), Carlos Mendez (Security), Procurement: procurement@northbridge.com
- Procurement / PO: We can accept standard PO or DocuSign. If procurement signs by 11/30 we can meet the 12/15 date.
- Security artifacts attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf and a short architecture sketch. If Carlos needs the full AOC, we'll coordinate with our security team (can take 48-72 hours to share).

Open flags for legal: there are two clauses procurement indicated they want clarified (data residency & indemnity cap). Legal is ready to do a 1:1 with Northbridge counsel — suggest scheduling that for the week of 11/22 so procurement can finish redlines before 11/30.

Next steps (internal + external):
- Ben to share MAP v2 to shared drive and send DocuSign envelope for signature once procurement confirms PO approach.
- Northbridge to confirm if they prefer PO vs DocuSign and introduce counsel if there are non-standard legal asks.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP_Northbridge_v2.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Connors <evan.connors@northbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: MAP v2 uploaded + go-live readiness checklist

Hi all — I uploaded the cleaned MAP (MAP_Northbridge_v2.xlsx) to our shared drive and added a short go-live readiness checklist in tab 3. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/nb/Map_Northbridge_v2

High level: we can meet 2026-12-15 go-live provided the following are done on this pace: 
- 11/22–11/24: legal touchpoint and redline closure (if needed)
- 11/30: procurement signs PO or confirms DocuSign path
- 12/01–12/04: infra provisioning + network validation (Lena & Redwood infra team)
- 12/05–12/08: pilot validation and acceptance testing (Northbridge product + Redwood CS)

I'll be the primary launch lead and will coordinate a daily sync the week of 12/01 if we have outstanding items.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

P.S. Ben — I set the DocuSign envelope to "ready" once procurement confirms PO route. If they want a PO first we can still proceed — we'll queue the PO against the envelope so signatures line up quickly.

From: Evan Connors <evan.connors@northbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Northbridge Procurement <procurement@northbridge.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@northbridge.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@northbridge.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP v2 uploaded + go-live readiness checklist

Marissa / team — thanks for the updates. Procurement confirms they will route a PO and target signature by 2026-11-29. Legal asks to do a short call on 11/23 to clarify indemnity language; I'll introduce counsel on that thread separately.

Carlos reviewed the SOC2 summary and asked for the AOC; Ben, can you share the AOC stub (if available) or the expected turnaround?

Assuming legal call on 11/23 and PO by 11/29, Northbridge confirms we accept the MAP as updated and are ready to proceed toward a 2026-12-15 go-live. Procurement will attach a PO (NB_PO_12015.pdf) to the DocuSign path once the PO is issued.

Evan
VP Product, Northbridge Systems
Evan.Connors@northbridge.com

From: Priyom Das <priom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Connors <evan.connors@northbridge.com>, Northbridge Procurement <procurement@northbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:52:00-08:00
Subject: Final confirmation: MAP acceptance & signature readiness

Evan — fantastic, thanks for the confirmation and for lining up procurement. Quick final notes from our side: 

- Ben / Security: I'll follow up separately on the AOC; we expect a 48–72 hour turnaround for the final AOC delivery after the call on 11/23.
- DocuSign / PO path: Ben will stage the DocuSign envelope and leave the PO slot open so procurement can attach NB_PO_12015.pdf. Once PO is attached and legal greenlights the redlines, we'll send the final DocuSign to the contacts on the procurement address.
- Go-live & acceptance: Per MAP acceptance criteria tab, Northbridge sign-off on latency and reranker MAP precision are required on 12/08 before production ramp. We will schedule the validation window now.

Next steps (action owners):
- 11/23: Legal call (Northbridge counsel + Redwood legal) — Evan to introduce counsel.
- 11/24: Security completes AOC delivery (Redwood) if requested.
- 11/29: Procurement attaches PO (NB_PO_12015.pdf).
- 12/01: Infra readiness confirmation (Lena).
- 12/08: Pilot validation sign-off (Northbridge product + Redwood CS).
- 12/15: Go-live (production ramp).

I'll queue a DocuSign envelope today and mark it pending until procurement attaches the PO. Thanks everyone — excited to get this across the line.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0143
